versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00055, SRS_Rte_00164 For each Array Implementation Data Type which last Implementation- DataTypeElement is of category STRUCTURE , the RTE Types Header File shall in- clude the corresponding type declaration as: typedef struct { <elements> } <name> ; where <elements> is the record element specification and <name> is the shortName of the Array Implementation Data Type ’s Imple- mentationDataTypeElement . For each record element defined by one ImplementationDataTypeElement one record element specification <elements> is defined. The record element specifica- tions are ordered according the order of the related ImplementationDataTypeEle- ment s in the input configuration. Sequent record elements are separated with a semicolon.
